Understand text from images, speech and other apps with TransVerse. %1$s

Getting started

Choose Text to paste or type, Image to extract printed text, Speech to dictate, or Barcode to scan a code. TransVerse detects the source language and translates to the language you select.

Quick capture

Quick capture adds a movable bubble over other apps. Android will ask for overlay, notification and screen-capture permission. Screen capture only begins after you approve Android’s system prompt, and you can stop it from the persistent notification.

Results

Tap links, email addresses and phone numbers in extracted entities to open the appropriate app. Other entities are copied. Use the copy buttons for original or translated text.

Privacy

Enable Incognito mode before analyzing sensitive text. Incognito results are not added to history. Translation language models may need to download before first use.

Privacy overview

TransVerse is designed around on-device processing. Captured text, translations, entities and scan history are stored locally on your device. The app does not require an account and does not upload your scan history to an Easit Limited server.

Data and models

Google ML Kit performs OCR, language identification, translation, Smart Reply, barcode scanning and entity extraction. Some ML models are delivered or downloaded through Google Play services and therefore require an internet connection for their initial download. Translation then runs on-device.

Permissions

Camera is used only when you choose camera or barcode capture. Microphone is used only for speech capture. Display-over-other-apps, notifications and media projection are used only for the optional Quick Capture feature. Android displays a system confirmation before each media-projection session.

Storage

History and captured media remain in app-controlled storage unless you explicitly export or share them. Incognito mode prevents new analysis results from being saved. Deleting history removes saved database records from this device.

Sharing

When you choose Share, open a link, dial a number or send an email, the selected content is handed to the external app you choose and becomes subject to that app’s privacy policy.

TransVerse uses open-source Android libraries and Google ML Kit components, including AndroidX, Material Components, Room, Hilt/Dagger, Navigation, Glide, Android Image Cropper and Gson.

Google ML Kit components are governed by Google’s API terms and attribution requirements. AndroidX, Material, Room, Hilt, Navigation and Gson are distributed under their respective open-source licences. Glide and Android Image Cropper retain their original project licences and copyright notices.

The authoritative dependency list and exact versions are maintained in the app module build file. Source distributions and licence texts are available from each project’s official repository.
